tenderSchedule.title: RFP FOR RENEWAL OF AMC FOR SPECTRALOGIC TAPE LIBRARY OF KSDC WITH ONE-YEAR SUPPORT
tenderSchedule.description: RFP FOR RENEWAL OF AMC FOR SPECTRALOGIC TAPE LIBRARY OF KSDC WITH ONE-YEAR SUPPORT

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room no 252, 2nd floor, 2nd gate, M S building

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a company registered in India under companies Act/Limited Liability partnership act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 5 Years as on bid date. (Consortium and joint ventures formed for the purpose of this project are not eligible to bid for this project. Trusts and societies are also not eligible to bid for this project)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed supplying/renewal of AMC for Tape Library of minimum value of one order of Rs.40 Lakhs or two orders of Rs.20 Lakhs each during last 7 Years as on bid submission date for any State Data Center/Data Center of PSUs/Enterprises.
The annual turnover of the Bidder during each of the last 3 financial Years (2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25) shall not be less than Rs.80 Lakhs (Eighty Lakhs)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for the last 3 financial Years (2022-23,2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have filed for bankruptcy

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration in this regard by the authorized signatory of the bidder should be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have at least one permanent/working office in Bengaluru

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Certificate issued by the HR head/Authorized signatory of the bidder organization.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by the Government of India or any state government or any of its agencies for any reasons whatsoever and the bidder should not have been blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices as on last date of bidding for this tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking from the Company Secretary or the Authorized Signatory

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: MAF to be submitted as per format in RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- MAF document to be provided by the OEM in their letter head.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have valid ISO 9001 and 27001 OR 20000.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid ISO certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The signatory for this RFP must be authorized by Board or Head of the Organization

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Authorization letter by Board or Head of Organization or Power of Attorney document.
